title: Project Overview
description: A project page with a brief, key facts and in-place tabs for tasks, files and activity, using real tab semantics.
summary: Project header with keyboard-operable tabs over four panels.
notes: The tabs enhancer owns aria-selected, roving tabindex, the hidden attribute on panels and arrow-key, Home and End navigation. Without JavaScript only the Overview panel is shown; render the other sections as separate pages if they must work without it.
Use real tabs only for panels that switch in place. For sections with their own URL, use links with aria-current="page" styled as .tabs instead.
Tasks, files and activity are static sample data.
